reading_template:
# Prompt and scoring follow lm-eval-harness d6de816's Belebele template.
# Data files are extracted from the SHA-locked Meta official ZIP.
dataset_path: json
dataset_name: null
test_split: test
output_type: multiple_choice
num_fewshot: 0
doc_to_text: "P: {{flores_passage}}\nQ: {{question.strip()}}\nA: {{mc_answer1}}\nB: {{mc_answer2}}\nC: {{mc_answer3}}\nD: {{mc_answer4}}\nAnswer:"
doc_to_choice: ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
doc_to_target: "{{['1', '2', '3', '4'].index(correct_answer_num)}}"
metric_list:
  - metric: acc
    aggregation: mean
    higher_is_better: true
  - metric: acc_norm
    aggregation: mean
    higher_is_better: true
metadata:
  version: 0.0
scope: Same definitions, prompts, decoders and scoring as executed; generated local paths and checksum manifest cover only the three used EN tasks.
